newsitem.title: SRI LANKA: Sri Lanka would-be assassin commits suicide.
newsitem.headline: Sri Lanka would-be assassin commits suicide.

text.p: A suspected Tamil rebel killed himself by swallowing cyanide on Wednesday after an abortive bid to shoot a police officer in northcentral Sri Lanka, military officials said.
The suspect tried to approach the officer in charge of the Nelukulam police station, west of Vavuniya town, 220 km (138 miles) north of Colombo, they said.
"When police prevented him from getting close he pulled out a pistol and opened fire but the shot went wide," said a military official in Vavuniya. "He then swallowed cyanide and died."

Liberation Tigers of Tamil Eelam (LTTE) rebels, fighting for an independent homeland for minority Tamils in the Indian Ocean island's north and east, keep cyanide suicide pills to avoid being captured.
The government says more than 50,000 people have died in the war, now in its 14th year. The LTTE say the toll is higher.
A spokesman of the LTTE was not immediately available for comment.
